svg.title: Wooden axe illustration and recipe text
svg.desc: A generated image of a crafting table and wooden axe appears beside the recipe catalog text. The three by three grid has planks in the top-left, top-middle and middle-left cells, and sticks in the middle-middle and bottom-middle cells. The other cells are empty.

g.text: A recipe the planner can read
Wooden axe · 3 oak planks + 2 sticks → 1 item
Catalog knowledge only; not a check of
